long_biography.plain_text:
Viktor Rashnikov was born in Magnitogorsk and joined its vast steel works as a repair-shop mechanic in 1967. While working, he trained in metal-forming engineering and advanced through production, supply and engineering posts. He became MMK's chief executive in 1997 and spent 14 years in the role. He then steadily bought shares on the market, eventually becoming its majority owner before moving to the chairmanship. Current records identify him as chairman and controlling shareholder of the steelmaker.

Rashnikov's interests remain closely tied to his home city. Forbes describes him as a passionate hockey supporter, while MMK records identify him as president of Metallurg Magnitogorsk since 1999. That sustained role adds a sporting chapter to a career otherwise rooted in the city's steel industry.
